description:
## Problem
Two changes made TPC-H results before and after them non-comparable, and nothing in a result bundle shows it:
- Commit ff1dec15e (#2683, 2026-10-07) runs every TPC-H power iteration on stream 0. Before it, each iteration used its own stream, with a different query order (`benchbox/core/tpch/power_test.py:203-204`) and, when seeded, different qgen parameters (`benchbox/core/tpch/benchmark.py:36-39`).
- Commit e23ba66c9 (#2622, 2026-10-04) made dbgen produce canonical customer and supplier addresses. Data generated earlier differs in content.

The result schema supports `benchmark.data_generation_version` and `data_generation_hash` (`benchbox/core/results/schema.py:435-438`), added under `add-data-generation-version-field-to-benchmarkresults-for-ch`. Yet neither a 2026-10-03 nor a 2026-10-12 Snowflake TPC-H bundle carries them. The datagen manifests do hold `data_generation_version`, `base_constants_hash` and `generator_binary_sha256`, but those values are not propagated into the bundle. No field records the power-stream policy either.

A careful manual comparability pass still marked the affected 2026-10-03 TPC-H baselines (sf0.1, sf1, sf10) as reproducible-exact. Compare tooling and the results explorer cannot detect the mismatch on any platform.

## Change
- Propagate the datagen manifest identity (data_generation_version, base_constants_hash or generator hash) into `benchmark.*` for generated benchmarks.
- Record a power-stream policy marker for TPC-H and TPC-DS power tests.
- Make `benchbox compare` and the explorer warn or refuse when these differ between compared runs.
